title: Route Context Explanation and Correction Affordance
phaseTitle: Workflow Router Screen Correction and Guided Current Action UI

repairTrigger.failedItem: It explains why the current action was selected.
repairTrigger.summary: Route Context exposes a large amount of information, but it does not clearly communicate to a non-technical Operator why the app selected the current action.

objective: Repair WC08 Route Context so it begins with a plain-language explanation of why the current action was selected, what happens next, what would change the route, and how the Operator can flag an incorrect route without mutating durable workflow state.
scope: Reorder or relabel tabs into a logical human workflow
acceptanceCriteria: Route Context starts with a plain-language Why this is the current action explanation.
Explanation states what evidence caused the route and what missing/pending evidence prevents the next route.
What happens next is visible in plain language.
What would change this route is visible in plain language.
There is a visible non-mutating route-correction/review affordance.
Detailed categories, paths, warning codes, and capability diagnostics are secondary.
Tab order or labels follow human workflow rather than implementation chronology.
Complete current action remains easy to reach.
Artifacts remains the only artifact list/preview surface.
Supporting/reference screens do not show the full Route Context inspector.
No WC07 clutter regression is introduced.

carriedForwardObservations.title: Route Context is too technical and does not explain progress
Operator needs a way to say the route is wrong
Tab order does not match human workflow
